name: COOKIE POLICY
meta_description: How LAMID ONE uses essential authentication tokens and operational cookies without third-party ad tracking.
title: Cookie Policy
description: Information on session authentication tokens and operational cookies utilized across LAMID ONE.

paragraphs.text: LAMID ONE uses essential security cookies and functional session state to deliver a secure, responsive operating environment.
We deploy secure session authentication tokens, CSRF protection tokens, and cryptographic state cookies strictly necessary to maintain your logged-in session and protect your workspace.
• Security Controls: Session cookies are encrypted, transmitted only over TLS, and protected with HttpOnly and SameSite flags.
We retain local UI state preferences—such as navigation sidebar states and engine filtering choices—to ensure a seamless progression across workspace tools without re-prompting.
• Operational Telemetry: Internal performance measurements are aggregated to diagnose server latency and computational engine throughput.
LAMID ONE maintains a strict zero-tracking policy: we do not load third-party ad networks, behavioural tracking pixels, or cross-domain profiling scripts across any user workspaces.
• Payment Providers: Secure payment dialogs (such as Paystack) operate in sandboxed frames during explicit funding events only.
